variants.name: Barricade
variants.collider: box 2.4 x 0.25 x 1.3 for the plank wall (blocks shots/movement) + 2 boxes for the back legs
variants.notes: Modelled: 8 planks (3 broken tops, 1 shot through into two pieces with a real gap), cracks/chips on every timber, front rail + stub, 2 back rails, diagonal back batten, board leaning on the back, 2 end posts with iron straps, 2 back legs lashed with rope (loose ends) and propped on flat stones, 6 bullet holes with splinters, nailed patch, ~40 nails, 8 pegs, 4 foot wedges, soil heaped along the front foot, clods/pebbles/chips/shavings/needles/leaves. Olive wear from the Wood texture.
